steps.title: The site's TypeScript type-checked: TypeScript pinned, and astro check a gate in check and CI

steps.title: Zod generated in-repo from the contracts, in the current Zod 4 API; the abandoned generator removed, and astro check failing on any hint
steps.source: json-schema-to-zod, abandoned March 2026, emitted z.string().datetime() seven times; astro check fails only on errors by default, so the deprecations passed as hints

steps.title: Binary provenance proved, not assumed: every task resolves each tool to its pinned location and version, checked as a task in every mode
steps.source: provenance held by one line of task configuration and nothing proved it; zizmor ran at latest behind a pinned action

steps.title: mise cannot update itself past its pin: a notice beside every install makes self-update and auto-update refuse
steps.source: a standalone mise self-updates normally; auto_update requires self-update to be available

steps.title: A suppression carries its code alone; its reason lives only in the register, and the floor refuses a description
steps.source: 23 suppressions duplicated the register's reason; 10 still promised a register that already existed

steps.title: A step claimed done is proved done: Plan-Done trailers checked against the evidence when claimed, and in CI ever after
steps.source: G.25 merged yet read as unfinished: its evidence named a file never written under that name, and nothing checked the claim

steps.title: Setup makes a checkout usable: the site installed from its lockfile, frozen, beside the Python half
steps.source: a fresh worktree failed four of ten gates with astro: command not found

steps.title: No package runner may install a tool at run time: every bun x, bunx and npx carries --no-install
steps.source: a test ran bun x astro build and bun fetched astro@latest from the registry

steps.title: A requirement's identity is one object: the step, the observation that justifies it, the evidence file, and the commits that claim it
steps.source: the team does not say the setup bug, it says G.38; 2026 traceability practice: ids issued once and never reused, links made when the work is made, the matrix generated and drift-gated

steps.title: Every command emits a typed outcome: the payload on stdout, progress on stderr, and a refusal carrying a machine code rather than prose
steps.source: reading a command meant grepping its output; 2026 agent-facing practice separates the streams and gives every outcome a contract and a deterministic exit code

steps.title: Source edits go through the syntax tree, not string anchors: a pinned structural codemod tool, with its transforms as tested rules
steps.source: repeated edit failures from text anchors and self-inspecting guards; 2026 practice calls agent text-editing non-deterministic and unverifiable

steps.title: One writer for the plan, from the model, and a gate that the committed file is what that writer produces
steps.source: steps were added by splicing a hand-built YAML block; 2026 practice for a file a program owns is one writer from the model, one canonical form, and a drift gate

steps.title: The site's toolchain warns about nothing: its React integration removed where unused, and every dependency pinned exactly
steps.source: astro check reported an unused React integration and a Vite 8 deprecation behind @astrojs/react; a range in package.json lets a build differ between machines

steps.title: No command rewrites lineage, and the remote refuses a rewrite: refresh merges, and branch protection is declared as data
steps.source: worktree:refresh rebased an unpushed branch, so its own commit stopped being reachable while the command reported success; the remote declares no ruleset, so develop and main are protected by a local hook alone

steps.title: The tooling's tests hold no explicit Any: every double implements a protocol this repository owns, and every builder names its shape
steps.source: unifying the mypy configuration revealed 61 explicit Any in tests that the tooling's own section had exempted module-wide; the wandb adapter's seam now has a protocol, as MLflow's already did, and the tests must implement it

steps.title: The ban on Any cannot be reopened, and the implicit forms are caught too
steps.source: sixty-one explicit sites accumulated behind a module-wide exemption with no count; disallow_any_explicit never sees Callable[..., X] or a bare container, and ANN401 checks only a function argument

steps.title: No gate reaches the network, and every gate is bounded in time
steps.source: eslint-effective.ts imported eslint with no node_modules, so bun auto-installed from the registry and held check_all for forty-one minutes printing nothing, because subprocess.run carried no timeout

steps.title: An observation that cannot see an evidence kind says so, rather than reporting it unmet
steps.source: staged_facts observed at the index knows no merged pull request, so every pr-kind requirement read as unmet -- G.2 blocked G.20 while PR 18 had merged long before; 2026 practice calls a negative reading void without a positive control

steps.title: No task modifies a tracked file merely by starting: uv runs frozen unless it is resolving on purpose
steps.source: mise run sync could not fast-forward a checkout eleven commits behind, because uv run reconciled the stale lockfile before the module started and the merge then found the file dirty -- a task unable to run on exactly the checkout that needs it

steps.title: The site's generated types exist before anything type-aware reads them
steps.source: site:lint failed with twenty-one no-unsafe errors in a fresh worktree and passed in one where site:types had run: Astro writes the types for astro:content only when it syncs, and nothing ordered the two

steps.title: The committed Zod is what the generator produces, proved by regenerating and comparing
steps.source: changing the generator's header left every committed .gen.ts stale and twenty-four tests passed: they check for deprecated APIs and loose shapes, and nothing regenerates and compares, so the data export has a drift gate its older sibling lacks

steps.title: Evidence declares how it is verified, so a file that cannot carry a marker is still confirmable
steps.source: the matrix confirms a path only through pytest.mark.requirement and reads only .py files, so twenty-seven completed steps proved by flake.nix, mise.toml, lefthook.yml or TypeScript are unconfirmable by construction; 2026 practice names inspection and analysis beside test execution

steps.title: The sheet's status is observed at render time, never typed into its markup
steps.source: the sheet claims 383 tests and 11 pull requests while the repository has 774 and 72; the figure was true when typed and has drifted ever since, which is the drift plan-as-data exists to end

steps.title: A dependency bot's commit is exempt from the trailer rule, and from nothing else
steps.source: a Dependabot bump reached develop with no Plan-Step trailer and failed CI on a branch that did not create it; a bot cannot name a plan step, so the gate could never pass -- the deterministic consequence of two correct components meeting

steps.title: The sheet fits on one page with room to spare, on every machine that renders it
steps.source: byte-identical HTML rendered one page on arm64 and two on an x86-64 runner, in the same pinned image: the layout fits with too little headroom, so a sub-pixel difference decides the page count

steps.title: Every render of the sheet is kept, stamped with when it was made
steps.source: each render overwrote the last, so two versions could never be compared and a regression in the layout left no trace of what it replaced

steps.title: The sheet's typefaces are Liberation Sans and DejaVu Sans Mono, vendored and pinned
steps.source: the sandbox sheet read better because its renderer substituted the system Liberation Sans and DejaVu Sans Mono; vendoring them keeps that look without depending on a machine's font folder

steps.title: The execution spine is legible in print, and fills the space it has
steps.source: its labels render at 6.1 to 6.6 point, the floor below which print needs a magnifier, while the column below it sits empty; 2026 print guidance puts comfortable secondary text at 8 point with leading a fifth greater again

steps.title: Negatives are type-constrained, and the sheet states their ratio, resampling and sharing
steps.source: 2026 reviews of biomedical KG link prediction require type-constrained sampling that avoids impossible combinations, and reporting the positive-to-negative ratio, the resampling strategy, and whether models share one negative set; the sheet says identical negatives, which is the sharing alone

steps.title: Every run records what it cost to compute, and the model card reports it
steps.source: 2026 reproducibility checklists name computational-resource reporting beside leakage-aware validation and simpler baselines; a rung that took a hundred GPU-hours and one that took two are not comparable on accuracy alone, and nothing here records either

steps.title: The step-level plan report as a one-page sheet, collected from the plan and filling its page
steps.source: the whole plan is readable only by running a console command; a printable report of every step with its state, dependencies, evidence and what is unmet is what a reader or reviewer can carry

steps.title: The exemption register has one writer, as the plan, the trace and the ledger each do
steps.source: it is the only context file edited by hand: two hand-edits in one session dropped its path header and the id its evidence depends on, breaking four gates, and put an entry in the scoped list where an inline noqa belongs

steps.title: The model card is a contract: identity, evidence, interpretation and what it may not claim
steps.source: three steps depend on a model card -- 9.15 writes it, 9.20 refuses it, E.35 feeds it -- and no contract says what it must contain; 2026 governance practice is blunt that structural presence is not substantive content, so the schema forces disaggregated slices and refuses boilerplate

steps.title: The README is generated from the plan and the toolchain, and drift-gated; the ban narrows to hand-written Markdown
steps.source: the repository has no front page, and G.28 forbids every Markdown file by suffix -- but its reasoning is that nothing checks prose against the code it describes, which a generated file answers; 2026 practice reversed exactly this rule, making the README a derived copy with a drift gate

steps.title: Every layer names the step that produces its record, and a gate walks the chain
steps.source: all nine layers have an owner in the plan and not one of those links is recorded: the binding is inferable by a person reading two documents and by nothing else, so a step could be removed, renamed or retargeted and no gate would notice; 2026 provenance practice binds each stage to the next so a link cannot be reordered, removed or inserted undetectably

steps.title: The README stores no figure its own commit changes: live signals, not counts
steps.source: it states completed steps, so the commit completing one makes the copy it carries stale before it lands -- three pushes refused in one day; 2026 practice removes hard-coded counts from a README in favour of signals that resolve when a reader looks, after the same numbers were bumped across four pull requests and conflicted on every rebase

steps.title: Signed means a DSSE envelope over an in-toto statement, logged for transparency
steps.source: five steps promise a signature or an attestation and not one names a mechanism; the card's attested_by is a bare digest, which is a number anyone can type -- 2026 practice is that a predicate document without a signature is a file anyone could have written, and that policies must consume the attestation predicate rather than the signature alone

steps.title: A layer states what it asks about, what generates its evidence, and whether that gap can be closed
steps.source: the nine layers are modelled and gate-walked, but the conflation at layer 1 lives only inside an English sentence: nothing typed says the question is about on-target biology while every observation comes from drug pharmacology, or that no engineering closes it

decisions.title: Bit-for-bit PDF reproduction on the laptop
decisions.reason: an Apple laptop runs the pinned amd64 image under emulation, which floors page sizes to whole inches; the native CI render is the record and the local render a preview

decisions.title: A GitHub App to perform promotion
decisions.reason: promotion runs under the owner's gh login, whose merge emits the push event release.yml needs; FleetManagement needed an App for ruleset bypass, and there are no rulesets here

decisions.title: A Makefile for builds and tasks
decisions.reason: every operation is a mise task; a Makefile would be a second task runner, the duplicate mise.toml exists to prevent
decisions.source: first plan, pillar-to-artifact table: Build as Code

decisions.title: Removing the sheet generator's lint exemptions
decisions.reason: the generator itself is retired by step 8.12, when the sheet becomes a route of the site
decisions.source: restored with C408, E501 and N806 scoped away and the formatter excluded

decisions.title: Turborepo as the task runner, once CI exceeds five minutes
decisions.reason: every operation is a mise task; a second task runner is the duplication mise.toml exists to prevent
decisions.source: first plan, stack table: task runner deferred

decisions.title: Node.js as a pinned runtime
decisions.reason: bun is the JavaScript runtime and package manager, pinned in toolchain.json; no Node is pinned and none is needed

decisions.title: Reliability, resilience and chaos engineering as code
decisions.reason: no running service to exercise beyond a static site, whose health check, rollback and scheduled check cover it

decisions.title: Identity, access control and entitlements as code
decisions.reason: a single-owner repository with no users or roles to model; workflow token permissions are already declared per job

decisions.title: Network policy as code
decisions.reason: no network to constrain beyond a static site behind Railway and Cloudflare, whose routing is the Caddyfile

decisions.title: The Python interpreter built by Nix
decisions.reason: uv provides the interpreter, identical on all three environments, so Nix never builds Python; toolchain.json pins uv, and uv enforces the version

decisions.title: A README.md
decisions.reason: the live site, derived from data, is the project's front door; the repository's description and homepage are settings, step 6.8
decisions.source: Git is the record of repository documentation; a Markdown file beside the code drifts from what it describes

decisions.title: A SECURITY.md

decisions.source: Git is the record of repository documentation; a Markdown file beside the code drifts from what it describes
